author: creativelunchclub
title: Looking for 12 cover artists for 2027
content: 🎨 Become one of our 12 cover artists for 2027! Every month we announce our meetups with a cover. In 2027, each one will be created by a different artist, and we’re looking for 12 visual artists to collaborate with. Your cover is your interpretation of Creative Lunch Club, in your own style and medium: illustration, animation, photo, collage, 3D, typography, or whatever you work in. What you get: → A fee of €150 → A feature as the artist in our monthly meetup post → Full creative freedom → All rights stay with you → Credit, tag and link wherever your cover appears We’re especially looking for emerging creatives. Bonus points if you’re a Creative Lunch Club member. Comment under the post and we’ll DM you the link.

author: whenthesilentbirdsings
title: Hiring Comic Artists, Lineartists and more
content: HIRING COMIC ARTISTS, WRITERS & MORE ⤵️ We’re looking for help with “When the Silent Bird Sings” and other studio projects. These positions include: Lineartist, sketch artist, colorist, storyboard artist, animators, music producers, language translators, comic writers/editors, personal assistants, video/reel editors/promoters, content creators & more. These positions are paid but we’re open to collaboration / internships.
